donts: Don't use hex, rgb(), or arbitrary color values in components or pages (bg-[#...], text-slate-*, border-slate-*, bg-white, text-white on primary).
Don't use native <button>, <table>, <select>, or <input type="text"> with inline styling — use shadcn <Button>, <Table>, <Select>, <Input>.
Don't hand-roll headings, containers, or confirm flows — no <h1> with classes, no container mx-auto py-8 px-4, no card-glass, no shadow-[rgba], no if (confirm()).
Don't use text-sm for body copy, text-base for section titles, or text-2xl font-semibold for page titles.
Don't compute radius with calc() or reach for rounded-3xl/4xl — only the six official steps.
Don't hardcode sidebar colors (#0F2B46, #1D3557, navy fills) or colored hard-offset shadows, gradient text, kickers/eyebrows, or glass-as-decoration.
dos: Do start every page with <PageContainer> and every header with <PageHeader>.
Do put the "Nova" button in the flush table section's actions, with table names in font-medium text-foreground and secondary columns in text-muted-foreground.
Do use <StatusBadge> for every status and <EmptyState> for every empty/denied state (ShieldAlert + "Sem permissão").
Do spell the census truth exactly: nome_completo, cpf, email, telefone_celular, telefone_fixo, logradouro, bairro, numero, complemento.
Do use tabular numerals for KPIs and counters (tabular-nums).
keyCharacteristics: Restrained single-accent system: steel blue does the talking, gold accents focus, deep steel supports.
Composition over invention: PageContainer, PageHeader, PageSection, FilterBar, FormCard, StatusBadge, ConfirmDialog, EmptyState, StatCard.
Flat by default with a 5-level elevation reserve for overlays only.
15 px body copy with a tight 9-step type scale and fixed rem sizes (no fluid display type in product UI).
Light-first SaaS surfaces with a true slate dark mode, never inverted brand blue.
narrative.overview: Bravery SGE is an Operate-mode workspace: secretaries, principals, and teachers complete structured tasks all day, so the interface disappears into the job. One sans family, one blue brand, tonal surfaces instead of shadows, and the same five page compositions everywhere. Density is welcome (wide tables, information-rich cards); decoration is not.

rules.body: No hex in components or pages; every color resolves to a globals.css token (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, border-border).
rules.name: The Token-Only Rule

rules.body: Primary blue marks the primary action, current selection, and state indicators only — never decoration or large fills.
rules.name: The One-Voice Rule

rules.body: Light-mode sidebar is deep steel, never white; hover is a white/12 wash with white text (text-sidebar-foreground, never text-accent-foreground — contrast).
rules.name: The Sidebar-Is-White Rule

rules.body: Body copy is 15px; text-sm (14px) as a description default and text-base (16px) as a section title are both violations.
rules.name: The Fifteen-Pixel Body Rule

rules.body: Only weights 400/500/600/700; no italics, no all-caps, no serif or decorative faces.
rules.name: The Weight-Ceiling Rule

rules.body: Resting cards use at most shadow-sm; shadow-md only on hover; shadow-lg/xl reserved for overlays. Declare elevation once — border or shadow, never a 1px border under a wide soft shadow.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
